context: The patients have shown no sign of recurrence at 9 months' follow-up. CONCLUSION Laparoendoscopic single-site totally extraperitoneal herniorrhaphy appears to be feasible and safe. It may be performed with readily available instruments, although further experience and practice are warranted for a more efficient repair.
target: The procedure has similar advantages to a multiport laparoscopic totally extraperitoneal procedure but yields better cosmetic results.
